parsed.explanation: The counterexample is valid: the global inequality e<q does not imply that every component is acyclic, and the selected component may contain a loop. Thus its asserted bipartition and inequality (3) are unjustified. A local repair is available: since the sum of component edge counts is less than the sum of component vertex counts, some connected component has e_C<v_C; connectedness gives e_C≥v_C−1, so that component is a loop-free tree. Selecting that component instead of the one containing a_q completes the argument.
